findings.suggested_change: Any additional services requested by the Client must be agreed upon in writing, detailing the scope and associated fees, prior to commencement.

findings.explanation: The client can request as many revisions as they want until they are completely satisfied, with no limit on time or effort.
findings.suggested_change: The Contractor will provide up to three (3) rounds of revisions for each Deliverable, after which further revisions may be subject to an additional fee.

findings.explanation: The client can request unlimited revisions without limit, potentially causing endless back-and-forth and delaying final delivery.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

Thank you for sending over the agreement. Before signing, I wanted to raise a few points regarding the relevant clause for clarification:

- The agreement states that any additional services requested should be performed at no additional charge. To clarify, any additional services must be agreed upon in writing, detailing the scope and associated fees, prior to commencement.
- The relevant clause allows for unlimited revisions until full satisfaction is achieved. The Contractor will provide up to three (3) rounds of revisions for each Deliverable, after which further revisions may be subject to an additional fee.
- The clause regarding post-launch support suggests work outside the defined scope is included in the Services. Any requests for services outside the defined scope require a written change order specifying the work and associated fees before commencement.
- The revision allowance is stated as unlimited. The revision allowance is limited to three rounds, unless otherwise mutually agreed upon in writing.

I look forward to finalizing the agreement. 

Best regards
